blurb: Byzantium, then Constantinople, then Istanbul: a capital of empires for 1,600 years.

facts.t: Emperor Justinian built Hagia Sophia in five years, finishing in 537. After the Ottoman conquest in 1453 it became a mosque, in 1934 a museum, and in 2020 a mosque again.
In 1453 Sultan Mehmed II had about 70 ships hauled overland on greased logs into the Golden Horn, behind the chain that blocked its mouth.
